    • calculateBitsPerSampleForError

      int calculateBitsPerSampleForError(float maxError)
      Calculate the minimum bits per sample that will provide the specified error tolerance. The settings are unaffected.
      Parameters:
      maxError - the allowable tolerance
      Returns:
      the (hypothetical) bits per sample

    • determineMinAndMaxSample

      void determineMinAndMaxSample(float[] storeMin, float[] storeMax, float[] storeQuantScale)
      Calculate 3 quantization parameters of the current settings. The settings are unaffected.
      Parameters:
      storeMin - storage for the minimum height (ignoring cNoCollisionValue) or MIN_VALUE if no samples have collision
      storeMax - storage for the maximum height (ignoring cNoCollisionValue) or MAX_VALUE if no samples have collision
      storeQuantScale - storage for the quantization scale factor

    • getBitsPerSample

      int getBitsPerSample()
      Return the number of bits per sample to use during compression. The settings are unaffected.
      Returns:
      the number of bits (≥1, ≤16)

    • getBlockSize

      int getBlockSize()
      Return the block size. The settings are unaffected.

      For culling purposes, the height field is organized in blocks of 2 * mBlockSize * mBlockSize triangles.

      Sensible values range from 2 to 8.

      Returns:
      the block size (in rows)
